Level.description_en:
The performance level of the ESSD used as a data disk. Valid values:

Duration.description_en:
The protection period of the preemptible instance. Unit: hours. Default value: 1. Valid values:

1: Alibaba Cloud guarantees that the instance will not be automatically released for 1 hour after it is created. After 1 hour, the system automatically compares the bid price with the market price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or reclaim the instance.
0: Alibaba Cloud does not guarantee that the instance will be retained for 1 hour after it is created. The system automatically compares the bid price with the market price and checks resource inventory to determine whether to retain or reclaim the instance.

Alibaba Cloud sends a notification through an ECS system event 5 minutes before the instance is reclaimed. Preemptible instances are billed by the second. We recommend that you select an appropriate protection period based on the estimated duration of your tasks
Duration.description_zh:
抢占式实例的保留时长，单位为小时。 默认值：1。取值范围：

1：创建后阿里云会保证实例运行 1 小时不会被自动释放；超过 1 小时后，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。
0：创建后，阿里云不保证实例运行 1 小时，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。

实例回收前 5 分钟阿里云会通过 ECS 系统事件向您发送通知。抢占式实例按秒计费，建议您结合具体任务执行耗时来选择合适的保留时长
Duration.title: Duration

The subscription duration of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit. This parameter takes effect and is required only when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid. SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy for the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter takes effect when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PostPaid. Valid values:

NoSpot: regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: preemptible instance with a specified maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: preemptible instance whose price is automatically determined based on the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot

SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
